terra.problem: The line says Jesus was rejected when He first taught in the synagogue. Luke 4:16–29 does not say this was His first time teaching there.
In “Jesus Grows Up,” the return from the temple after Jesus’ birth is not described in Luke 2:39–52. Say His parents returned to Nazareth, or expand the passage to include Luke 2:22–38.
“Can Anything Good Come?” takes place at an unspecified location, not necessarily in Nazareth. John 1:45–51 mentions Nazareth but does not say Philip and Nathanael were there.
